title: Opening hours
text: BrewByte opens at 07:00 and closes at 19:00. Public opening hours apply at all locations.

title: Refund requests
text: For a refund request, contact staff. A manager reviews refunds. The assistant cannot approve or promise a refund.

title: Service recovery
text: Staff record an incorrect drink order and ask the manager before issuing a refund. Service recovery must cite the order record.

title: Account support
text: Staff report login problems to the support queue. Never share passwords in a ticket or assistant prompt.

title: Manager refund review
text: Manager-only refund review requires an order record and approval evidence. SYN-MANAGER-CANARY is a synthetic access-test marker, not a real secret.

title: Security incident escalation
text: Managers review repeated failed login events and retain evidence IDs. The assistant proposes actions in dry-run mode and cannot disable accounts.
